description: Use two disclosed early checkpoints to compare asymptotic loss decay and a capacity-dependent decay law on held-out architectures. The inferred loss floor is a conditional quantity, not measured data entropy.
independent_unit: Frozen complete-architecture assignments, identical to historical compact-v2 partitions
limitations: Known power-law scaling family with observed early calibration
An algebraically inferred floor is not a measured entropy or an independent learned parameter
Whole architectures held out; common training corpus, no external-model replication
title: Learning dynamics beyond early checkpoints
